notes.title: Updates since leaving Early Access
notes.notes:
Hi everyone,

We'd just like to take a moment to compile a list of the updates and bug fixes that PlataGO! has received since leaving Early Access:

Build 1.010
-Fixed issue where both game and system cursor were being shown.
Build 1.009
- Expanded what can be joined and dragged in editor. Now it's possible to easily move or extend newly drawn ladders, spikes, etc.
Build 1.008
- Fixed bottom alignment when in game mode.
Build 1.007
- Fixed countdown timer not pausing when game is paused.
- Fixed issue where some things are not deleted on level restart/death.
- Fix for gem counting issues caused by above issue.
Build 1.005
- Tweak to controller cursor move speed.
Build 1.0044
- Editor Drag added to right mouse and controller B button.
- Fixed some issues to do with dragging/resizing of tile regions (Note: At present this doesn't work with objects such as spikes and ladders but is being looked into!).
- Improved/fixed button navigation during pop-ups (to allow easier fine control of settings when using controller).
- Modified controller cursor response curve to allow for better control.
Build 1.003
- Fix for Steam library compatibility issue in previous build.
Build 1.002
- Fixed issue where the level link screen sometimes showed no levels.
Build 1.001
- Fixed it so that falling boxes kill enemies.
- Added a HUD door key indicator.
- Added a health bar indicator for enemies with more than 5 health.

And coming soon:
- Ability for NPCs to switchable objects after they talk.
- Ability for enemies to trigger switchable objects after being killed.
- Fixed recoil on charged weapon.
- Fixed issue when placing teleport directly at the top of a ladder.
- Fixed issue where jumping in a portal near the bottom of a level could cause the player to die.
- Fixed camera pan for switch with timer.


Thanks for playing and building!
PQube and Super Icon

notes.title: PlataGO! leaves Steam Early Access from today
notes.notes:
[i]The perfect platformer doesn’t exist… so make it yourself in [b]PlataGO![/b]
[/i]
…

Hi Everyone! 

Today is the day that [b]PlataGO![/b] finally builds its way out of Steam Early Access, and levels up to a full game release. You can watch the new Launch Trailer here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UEXpJCjAduI&feature=youtu.be&utm_source=sendinblue&utm_campaign=PlataGO%21__Out_Now__PQube&utm_medium=email
The full version of this DIY game maker comes with all the amazing creations submitted in our Steam Early Access Community Contest – which includes a mini-RPG, super-hard gauntlets, and many more creative platforming challenges. 

But with an ever-expanding library of community created content, there’s already loads more content available online -  and they’re all downloadable for free! Shape and add your own design to a permanently increasing selection of worlds, levels and complete games. With thousands of customisation options and filters from across gaming history, you can easily create a modern classic in minutes and share it with your friends instantly. 

A full release means the game now has a full price, so from today [b]PlataGO![/b] will be available on Steam for [b]£17.99/€19.99/$19.99[/b]. To everyone who supported the game during the Early Access period, both Super Icon and PQube Games would like to thank you all for your support. Your feedback and enthusiasm was an essential part of developing and releasing [b]PlataGO![/b]

Thanks again, and have fun with your creations!

notes.title: Here are the winners of the Switch contest!
notes.notes:
Dear builders,

we are happy to announce the winners of the Nintendo Switch contest! Creators were able to enter their favourite worlds and levels for a chance to be included in the Nintendo Switch version of PlataGO!, releasing later this spring.

As a little bonus, it is a pleasure to also reveal that most of the levels will be featured in the official launch trailer of the game (released on release), as well as in an official press release, going out today!

Without further ado, here come your winners: 

[b]Mr Run and Jump - [i]Multiple creations[/i][/b]
[b]Mr Run and Jump[/b] has been a content creator for PlataGO! since the first hour and entered with multiple creations and packs of his, which are all great in different ways. Creative layout of the gauntlets, intelligent use of the game's features and adjustable difficulty with the right amount of checkpoints make his entry an easy pick for the Nintendo Switch version. Given his outstanding contribution, we decided to include multiple packs of his in the final game!

[b]Backside Games - [i]Cavern of Ruiloba[/i][/b]
[i]Cavern of Ruiloba[/i] is very challenging but all the more satisfying when you start to learn the different tricks to every part of the big level. Navigate through it without missing any of the gems and remember that you have a wall jump - there might be secrets where you don't expect them to be!

[b]iaquer - [i]The Kingdom of Platagonia[/i][/b]
"The hero Mattia must cross the lands of Platagonia to save the princess Gioia and restore peace to the kingdom." A classic hero story brought to life in PlataGO!, [i]The Kingdom of Platagonia[/i] sends you on an adventure through multiple environments, makes intelligent use of different game mechanics and has a nice flow to it!

[b]sirdrak - [i]Go up![/i][/b]
The name says it all - [i]Go up![/i] is a simple but lovely level featuring satisfactory jumps, a fitting theme and includes multiple mechanics to keep players busy on the way to the top! Well done!

[b]KLGB76  - [i]Robots in the Forest[/i][/b]
Cool hidden passages and smart usage of dropping blocks to guide players over spikes are only some of the highlighs of this forest! A realistic amount of gems to collect together with the appealing layout make [i]Robots in the Forest[/i] a really enjoyable level!

All levels can be found in the comments of this news post: steamcommunity.com/games/PlataGO/announcements/detail/1692687668323016598

Once again thank you to all participants, we hope you still enjoy building and improving levels with PlataGO! and are excited for the full release as much as we are!

Kind regards,
the PlataGO!-Team

notes.title: Enter here with your level for the Switch contest!
notes.notes:
Dear builders,

the time has come to show off your creations! 

As announced earlier, we want to thank you for your support and pick some levels/games of yours to include them in the Nintendo Switch version of our game, releasing early next year. We already saw some amazing designs from you so far and it doesn't matter when the you originally uploaded it, so please follow the guidelines below to make sure you are actually entering the contest!

1. Upload your level to the Steam Workshop and link it in the comments of this thread by the December 31st 2018. Add the name of the level and the name you want to appear as to the comment as well.

2. We will pick three winners. Deciding factors will be everything that make a level/world enjoyable, including innovation, overall design, humor etc.

3. Creators must use the pre-built themes in the game.

An example entry could look like this:
"Hey everyone,
I'm SuperIcon and I'd like to enter with my level "SuperIcon's Sawblade Serenade": <link to level on the Steam Workshop>"

We hope everything is clear, but please let us know if you have any questions!

Alright then, builders - happy crafting and we're very looking forward to seeing what you have in store for us!

Kind regards,
the PlataGO!-Team

notes.title: WELCOME TO PLATAGO!
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32256453/af7f776efa9c70d2821eb9bbef01f86d5f7237eb.png[/img]

A BIG thank you to everyone who has just joined the PlataGO! community.

We wanted to kick things off by welcoming you all to our Early Access. It is always a nerve-wracking time to put something out there and hope that a community takes hold - to everyone who has been kind enough to buy PlataGO! a heartfelt thank you. It means so much to us.

Right now the core of PlataGO! will let you make some pretty sophisticated platforming levels. Please don't be shy in sharing your creations, creating new assets and putting your creativity to the test - to make levels and games for the community. 

We will also be regularly participating in the Discussions section, where we are very keen to hear your suggestions. If you like something (or not!) we want to hear about it. Feel there's a crucial feature missing? Please let us know.

Together we can help shape the future of PlataGO! for the better. We're excited to start this journey with you!

If you are only just joining us, then a good place to start would be with the Beginner's Guide and Overview in the Guides section. 

In the meantime, enjoy PlataGO! and unleash your hidden game design talent! ^_^

Thanks to you all,
The PlataGO! Team
